author: Team 1635
title: A late night in the shop
excerpt: The team turns a rough prototype into a working mechanism.
body:
The shop was still loud at 9:42 p.m. as we tested the latest prototype.

What changed

We adjusted the intake geometry and made the mechanism easier to service between matches.

Next test

Tomorrow we will test repeatability, driver control and durability.
